hard_failures: Problem 8 requires an explanation using the fraction bar and problem 10 requires a one-sentence diagnosis of adding denominators; both are falsely presented as fully machine-verifiable with zero manual items.

errors.description: Two explicit explanatory responses are reduced to scalar fraction checks and omitted from the manual count.
The final response describes a three-page worksheet; the rendered worksheet has five pages.

artifact_findings: The bars and detailed key correctly preserve like denominators and simplify results.
rationale: Correct, well-scaffolded fraction work is offset by a false zero-manual claim for two required explanations and an inaccurate delivery page count. The trust-boundary defect is decisive.
